name: Julian Erosa
event: UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs. Nolan
summary: A 37-year-old Xtreme Couture veteran from Yakima (31-13, 9-9 UFC) who wins high-volume brawls and scrambles but has been knocked out often: two straight losses, the last a three-knockdown R1 KO by Lerryan Douglas in March. Has never been submitted.

how_they_fight.Striking: Volume brawler: about 6.3 significant strikes landed and 5.7 absorbed per minute. Long (188 cm reach) and busy with one-twos, knees, kicks and spinning backfists; content to trade in the pocket. Cageside Press: "Defense has never been a staple" of his game.
how_they_fight.Grappling: A real finishing threat: 14 of his 31 wins are submissions, including UFC finishes of Ricardo Ramos and Christian Rodriguez in R1 and come-from-behind R3 subs of Sean Woodson and Charles Jourdain after being knocked down in both. Hunts takedowns when the stand-up gets bad (3 of 10 vs Melquizael Costa).
how_they_fight.Defense: The weak point. Eight KO/TKO losses, five of them in R1 inside the UFC (Devonte Smith, Seung Woo Choi, Alex Caceres, Fernando Padilla, Douglas). Douglas dropped him three times in 3:33 (Cageside Press). Broke an orbital and his nose in the Costa fight, per MMA Mania. Never submitted.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Tank is excellent; he gets better as a fight turns into a mess. Finishes by round across his career: R1 9, R2 10, R3 6, R4 1 (12 KO/TKO, 14 SUB, 5 decisions). Losses: eight KO/TKO (R1 6, R2 1, R3 1) and five decisions. The danger window is early: if he survives R1, he usually ends up in a high-output decision or a late scramble finish. His three-fight win streak (Ramos, Rodriguez, Darren Elkins) were all R1 finishes, though.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced and opportunistic; rarely panics on the ground. Takes a lot of damage to land his own, and doesn't adjust his defense against faster, harder punchers.

patterns: Volume plus scrambles; submissions from front-headlocks and back takes
Comebacks: submitted Woodson and Jourdain in R3 after being dropped
R1 KO losses to fast power punchers (five in the UFC)
Never submitted; decision losses come against technical strikers (Costa) or wrestlers (Grant Dawson)
concerns: Age 37, two straight losses, the last a brutal R1 KO seven months ago
Chin and defense against an aggressive early puncher
Accumulated damage (orbital fracture vs Costa, May 2025)
keys_to_beat: Land clean early: most of his losses come in R1
Don't grapple loosely with him; avoid scrambles and front-headlock exchanges
Use speed and counters rather than a volume trade

news.text: Booked against Lee Jeong-yeong at featherweight for Oct. 31; both on two-fight skids (Heavy).
Lost to Lerryan Douglas by R1 KO (3:33) in Seattle after three knockdowns.
Record disagreement: our verified data and the Yakima Herald have him 31-13; UFC.com lists 31-14.
